purpose: One record per reply that names the normalization, the matched category, the phase walk, the SRAI hops, the XCFE dispatches, the predicate traffic and the admission/commit outcome — so a reply can be audited without replaying the conversation.
why: The daemon has several observation surfaces (a route string, a selection score, a predicate map) and none of them says which phase produced which value. A trace makes the phase walk explicit and keeps the authority chain visible: every recorded admission is false unless a host callback said otherwise, and every recorded commit is false because a pattern engine has no commit path.

boundary.note: A trace may be written to memory or shown in the UI. It may not be replayed as evidence of admission, and a recorded XCFE dispatch is a call attempt, not a granted operation.

schema.id: string; unique within the emitting engine instance, monotonic
schema.parent: string|null; the trace id of the SRAI parent, null for a top-level reply
schema.depth: integer 0..16; SRAI recursion depth, MAX_DEPTH is 16

input.raw: string; the utterance exactly as received
input.normalized: string; the case-folded, substitute-applied, punctuation-collapsed form the matcher used
input.substitutions: array of {find, replace}; one entry per substitution rule that fired

schema.phases: array of 6 {phase, status, detail} in the canonical order; status is entered|skipped|failed|not_reached
schema.match: null | {id, pattern, topic, phase, source, specificity}; null means no category matched
schema.captures: array of {slot, value}; slot is 1-based, matching W8 of wildcard-control-flow
schema.srai: array of {target, depth, child, matched, status}; one entry per redirect
schema.children: array of nested reply traces, one per SRAI hop; bounded by depth
schema.xcfe: array of {op, admitted, authority, dispatch}; admitted is false for a pattern engine, dispatch is host|unbound

predicates.get: array of {name, found}; found means the predicate existed, not that its value was verified
predicates.set: array of {name, value}; a write is recorded, never treated as learning

schema.conditions: array of {name, value, matched, fallback}; one entry per <condition> evaluated

mode.value: string|null; the behavior mode that filtered candidate selection
mode.narrows_only: constant true; a mode narrows selection and never grants admission

schema.admission: constant {owner: XCFE, admitted: false, reason: pattern_match_only}
schema.commit: constant {authorized: false, phase: Xul, reason: trace_is_observation_only}
schema.steps: array of {seq, phase, event, detail}; the ordered execution log, seq starts at 1

phase_walk.phase_identity: Chen / Ch_en / Ch'en are one phase, canonicalised at the parser boundary (world::canonical_phase_name)

laws.T1: every reply records exactly one entry per canonical phase, in canonical order, and every entry carries a status
laws.T2: a skipped phase states why it was skipped; Yax is skipped because a deterministic rule match has no generation stage
laws.T3: the phase walk is recorded, not performed: recording a Ch'en entry does not verify anything and recording a Xul entry does not commit
laws.T4: the trace never wraps Xul to Pop inside one record; a redirect starts a child trace with parent set, which is the new-execution boundary of runtime-graph

data/grammar/scfml.normalization.json.law: MISS is recorded as no_match, never as a contradicted condition; UNKNOWN is not recorded as else

data/grammar/wildcard-control-flow.contr.law: a capture is recorded as a capture; it is never recorded as a resolved condition (W1)

data/grammar/srai-operators.contracts.js.law: a hop is recorded before the child text is emitted; an operator without a host dispatch records dispatch:unbound and stays a proposal

data/grammar/runtime-graph.contracts.jso.law: a recorded phase step is a candidate route, never an authorization (RG6)

data/grammar/xcfe-aiml.contract.json.law: the pattern engine has no XCFE callback, so admission.admitted and commit.authorized stay false

data/grammar/xcfe-modes.contracts.json.law: a mode filters candidate selection and is recorded as narrowing only (M1, MODE4)

data/grammar/operator-algebra.contracts..law: operators declare and are recorded; none of them admits or commits (OA6)

data/grammar/relation-aliases.contracts..law: a recorded RELATION dispatch never promotes an alias spelling to a VerifiedRelation

invariants.TR1: one trace per reply; SRAI children are nested, never spliced into the parent
invariants.TR2: the schema field is exactly daemon-bot.reply-trace.v1 and the phase order is exactly Pop, Wo, Yax, Sek, Ch'en, Xul
invariants.TR3: input.normalized is the value the matcher used; a trace whose normalized form differs from the matched input is invalid
invariants.TR4: admission.admitted and commit.authorized are false unless a host callback set them; a pattern engine sets neither
invariants.TR5: no trace field may be read back as permission, verification or a committed fact
invariants.TR6: a render failure records render_error, marks Xul failed and rethrows; a failed trace is never reported as ok
invariants.TR7: trace ids are monotonic within one engine instance and unique across a conversation

fixtures: reply with an SRAI redirect records srai[0].child and children[0].parent = trace.id
reply with no match records status no_match and no capture
reply with a substitution records input.substitutions
reply with an <xcfe> node records xcfe[0].admitted = false
